segments.src: A part that costs $9.20 instead of $10.00 is not cheaper if it fails inspection twice as often or ships from three weeks farther away.
segments.tr: القطعة التي تكلف 9.20 دولار بدلاً من 10.00 دولارات ليست أرخص إذا كانت تفشل في الفحص ضعف المرات، أو إذا كانت تُشحن من مسافة أبعد بثلاثة أسابيع.

segments.src: Not every purchase deserves the same effort.**
segments.tr: ليست كل عملية شراء تستحق الجهد نفسه.**

segments.src: The standard tool here is the **Kraljic matrix**, which sorts everything you buy along two axes: how much money is involved, and how risky the supply is (few suppliers, fragile source, long lead time).
segments.tr: الأداة المعيارية هنا هي **مصفوفة كرالجيك**، التي تصنّف كل ما تشتريه وفق محورين: حجم المال المنفق، ومدى خطورة مصدر التوريد (عدد قليل من الموردين، أو مصدر هش، أو مدة توريد طويلة).

segments.src: That gives four quadrants, each with a different playbook:
segments.tr: يُنتج ذلك أربعة أرباع، ولكل منها دليل عمل مختلف:

segments.src: - **Non-critical** (low spend, low risk) — office supplies, cleaning goods. Automate it. Use a catalog, a P-card, and stop thinking about it.
segments.tr: - **غير حرج** (إنفاق منخفض، مخاطرة منخفضة): اللوازم المكتبية ومواد التنظيف. أتمتها: استخدم كتالوجاً ومحفظة بطاقات للمشتريات، وكفّ عن التفكير فيها.

segments.src: - **Leverage** (high spend, low risk) — commodity packaging, standard fasteners. Many capable suppliers want your volume. Compete them, consolidate volume, negotiate hard.
segments.tr: - **الرافعة** (إنفاق مرتفع، مخاطرة منخفضة): التغليف السلعي والمثبتات القياسية. كثير من الموردين القادرين يرغبون في حجم طلباتك. نافِس بينهم، ووحّد الحجم، وفاوض بصرامة.

segments.src: - **Bottleneck** (low spend, high risk) — a proprietary sensor, a single certified calibration lab. Small money, big pain if it stops. Hold safety stock, qualify a backup, sign a longer contract.
segments.tr: - **نقطة الاختناق** (إنفاق منخفض، مخاطرة مرتفعة): حساس مملوك حصرياً، أو مختبر معايرة معتمد وحيد. المال قليل، لكن الألم كبير إذا توقف. احتفظ بمخزون احتياطي للأمان، وأهِّل مورداً بديلاً، ووقّع عقداً أطول.

segments.src: - **Strategic** (high spend, high risk) — the engine, the chip, the signature ingredient. Few alternatives, enormous impact. Build a genuine partnership, share forecasts, invest in the relationship.
segments.tr: - **استراتيجي** (إنفاق مرتفع، مخاطرة مرتفعة): المحرك، والشريحة، والمكوّن المميز. بدائل قليلة، وأثر هائل. ابنِ شراكة حقيقية، وشارك التوقعات، واستثمر في العلاقة.

segments.src: The mistake almost every under-resourced team makes is spending its best people on the wrong quadrant — running competitive bids on paper towels while the sole-source component nobody has a backup for quietly becomes an existential risk.
segments.tr: الخطأ الذي يقع فيه تقريباً كل فريق يعاني من نقص الموارد هو صرف أفضل كوادره على الربع الخطأ: إجراء مناقصات تنافسية على مناشف المطبخ، بينما يتحول المكوّن الوحيد المتوفر من مورد واحد، والذي لا يملك أحد بديلاً له، بهدوء إلى خطر وجودي.

segments.src: Make-or-buy is a strategic choice, not a spreadsheet.**
segments.tr: قرار التصنيع أو الشراء قرار استراتيجي، لا مسألة جداول حسابية.**

segments.src: Outsourcing tends to win on cost, flexibility, and access to specialized capability.
segments.tr: غالباً ما يتفوق الإسناد الخارجي في التكلفة والمرونة والوصول إلى قدرات متخصصة.

segments.src: Keeping it in-house tends to win on control, quality assurance, IP protection, and responsiveness.
segments.tr: بينما يتفوق الاحتفاظ بالعمل داخلياً في الرقابة وضمان الجودة وحماية الملكية الفكرية وسرعة الاستجابة.

segments.src: The durable rule of thumb: **outsource what is not your core competency, and be extremely careful outsourcing anything a customer would notice.** The catch is that outsourcing doesn't remove risk — it converts execution risk into supplier risk.
segments.tr: القاعدة العملية الدائمة: **أسنِد ما ليس من كفاءتك الجوهرية، وكن شديد الحذر في إسناد أي شيء قد يلاحظه العميل.** والمفارقة أن الإسناد لا يُزيل المخاطر، بل يُحوّل مخاطر التنفيذ إلى مخاطر على المورد.

segments.src: Boeing's 787 program is the textbook case: an aggressive outsourcing model spread design and fabrication across a deep global supplier tier, and the resulting integration and coordination problems contributed to years of delay.
segments.tr: برنامج طائرة Boeing 787 هو المثال الكلاسيكي: نموذج إسناد طموح وزّع التصميم والتصنيع على شبكة واسعة من الموردين العالميين، وأسهمت مشكلات التكامل والتنسيق الناتجة في تأخيرات استمرت سنوات.

segments.src: Contracts don't manage relationships.
segments.tr: العقود لا تدير العلاقات.

segments.src: People do.**
segments.tr: الناس هم من يديرونها.**

segments.src: **Supplier Relationship Management (SRM)** is the practice of segmenting suppliers, scoring them on real metrics, and investing management attention where it pays off.
segments.tr: **إدارة علاقات الموردين (SRM)** هي ممارسة تقسيم الموردين، وتقييمهم بمقاييس فعلية، وتوجيه اهتمام الإدارة حيث يُثمر.

segments.src: A typical scorecard runs on **QCDS** — quality (defect rate, PPM), cost (price trend, cost-reduction ideas), delivery (on-time-in-full percentage), and service (responsiveness, technical support).
segments.tr: تعتمد بطاقة التقييم النموذجية على **QCDS**: الجودة (معدل العيوب، وعدد الأجزاء المعيبة في المليون PPM)، والتكلفة (اتجاه الأسعار، وأفكار خفض التكلفة)، والتسليم (نسبة التسليم في الموعد وبالكامل)، والخدمة (سرعة الاستجابة، والدعم الفني).

segments.src: You cannot run a deep partnership with 4,000 suppliers, and you shouldn't try.
segments.tr: لا يمكنك إقامة شراكة عميقة مع 4000 مورد، ولا ينبغي أن تحاول ذلك.

segments.src: You run transactional discipline with most of them, preferred-supplier terms with a couple hundred, and true joint development with the handful that determine whether your product is any good.
segments.tr: تُدير الانضباط التعاملي مع معظمهم، وشروط المورد المفضل مع بضع مئات، والتطوير المشترك الحقيقي مع حفنة قليلة تحدد ما إذا كان منتجك جيداً فعلاً.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## في الحياة اليومية

segments.src: Say you run **Trailhead Coffee**, a nine-location café chain in Austin.
segments.tr: لنفترض أنك تدير **Trailhead Coffee**، سلسلة مقاهٍ من تسعة فروع في أوستن.

segments.src: Annual revenue is $6.2 million, net margin about 5%, and roughly $2.4 million a year goes out the door to suppliers.
segments.tr: إيراداتك السنوية 6.2 مليون دولار، وهامش صافي الربح نحو 5%، وينفق نحو 2.4 مليون دولار سنوياً على الموردين.

segments.src: Your buying list sorts itself into the quadrants almost immediately.
segments.tr: تنقسم قائمة مشترياتك إلى الأرباع تقريباً فور النظر إليها.

segments.src: **Green coffee beans — strategic.** Around $520,000 a year, and your entire brand rests on it.
segments.tr: **حبوب القهوة الخضراء: استراتيجية.** نحو 520,000 دولار سنوياً، وعلامتك التجارية بأكملها تقوم عليها.

segments.src: There is no interchangeable substitute; customers can taste a switch.
segments.tr: لا يوجد بديل قابل للتبديل؛ فالزبائن يستطيعون تذوق الفرق عند تغيير المصدر.

segments.src: So you don't run this on an annual bid.
segments.tr: لذلك لا تدير هذا البند عبر مناقصة سنوية.

segments.src: You sign a multi-year agreement with your Chiapas importer, visit the co-op, share your growth forecast so they can plan their crop, and accept that you'll pay a little more for consistency and first call on the good lots.
segments.tr: بل توقّع اتفاقاً متعدد السنوات مع مستورد حبوبك في تشياباس، وزُر التعاونية، وشارك توقعات نموّك حتى يتمكنوا من تخطيط محصولهم، وتقبّل أنك ستدفع قليلاً أكثر مقابل الثبات وأولوية الحصول على الدفعات الجيدة.

segments.src: **Cups, lids, and sleeves — leverage.** About $310,000 a year, and a dozen distributors in Texas would love the business.
segments.tr: **الأكواب والأغطية والأكمام: الرافعة.** نحو 310,000 دولار سنوياً، وعشرة موزعين في تكساس يرحبون بالتعامل معك.

segments.src: This is where a competitive RFQ pays.
segments.tr: هنا يُجدي طلب عروض أسعار تنافسي نفعاً.

segments.src: You consolidate all nine stores onto one contract instead of letting each manager order locally, and you land 9% off — roughly $28,000.
segments.tr: توحّد الفروع التسعة في عقد واحد بدلاً من أن يطلب كل مدير احتياجاته محلياً، فتحصل على خصم 9%، أي نحو 28,000 دولار.

segments.src: **Espresso machine service — bottleneck.** Maybe $18,000 a year.
segments.tr: **صيانة ماكينة الإسبريسو: نقطة اختناق.** ربما 18,000 دولار سنوياً.

segments.src: Trivial money.
segments.tr: مبلغ زهيد.

segments.src: But exactly one certified tech in the metro services your machines, and if a grouphead fails on a Saturday at your busiest store, you lose $2,800 in a day.
segments.tr: لكن يوجد فني معتمد واحد فقط في المدينة يصونها، وإذا تعطّل رأس التسخين في أكثر فروعك ازدحاماً يوم السبت، تخسر 2,800 دولار في يوم واحد.

segments.src: So you pay for a service contract with a guaranteed four-hour response, and you keep a spare set of critical parts on the shelf.
segments.tr: لذلك تدفع مقابل عقد صيانة يضمن الاستجابة خلال أربع ساعات، وتحتفظ بمجموعة احتياطية من القطع الحرجة على الرف.

segments.src: Small spend, deliberate attention.
segments.tr: إنفاق صغير، واهتمام مقصود.

segments.src: **Office and cleaning supplies — non-critical.** Around $40,000.
segments.tr: **اللوازم المكتبية ومواد التنظيف: غير حرجة.** نحو 40,000 دولار.

segments.src: Put it on a punch-out catalog with one distributor, give managers a spending limit, and never hold a meeting about it again.
segments.tr: ضعها في كتالوج شراء مباشر لدى موزع واحد، وامنح المديرين حداً للإنفاق، ولا تعقد اجتماعاً بشأنها مرة أخرى أبداً.

segments.src: Now the part that makes the CFO sit up.
segments.tr: الآن الجزء الذي يجعل المدير المالي ينتبه.

segments.src: That $28,000 saved on cups is $28,000 of pure operating profit.
segments.tr: الـ 28,000 دولار التي وفّرتها على الأكواب هي 28,000 دولار من الربح التشغيلي الصافي.

segments.src: To generate the same $28,000 through sales at a 5% net margin, you'd have to sell **$560,000** more coffee — roughly a tenth of the entire business.
segments.tr: ولكي تحقق المبلغ نفسه من خلال المبيعات بهامش صافي 5%، ستحتاج إلى بيع **560,000** دولار إضافية من القهوة، أي نحو عُشر الأعمال كلها.

segments.src: That's the **profit-leverage effect**, and it's why procurement is one of the highest-return functions in a company that nobody outside the building ever thinks about.
segments.tr: هذا هو **أثر الرافعة على الربح**، ولهذا تُعد المشتريات من أعلى الوظائف عائداً في الشركة، رغم أن أحداً خارج المبنى لا يفكر فيها أبداً.

segments.src: The catch: chase that saving into the wrong quadrant — switch to a cheaper green coffee supplier to save $30,000 — and you may lose regulars who never tell you why they stopped coming.
segments.tr: لكن الحذر: إذا طاردت ذلك التوفير في الربع الخطأ، كأن تبدّل مورد القهوة الخضراء بآخر أرخص لتوفير 30,000 دولار، فقد تخسر زبائنك الدائمين الذين لن يخبروك أبداً بسبب توقفهم عن المجيء.

segments.src: Savings that damage the product aren't savings.
segments.tr: التوفير الذي يُضرّ بالمنتج ليس توفيراً.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## ملخص من ثلاثة أسطر

segments.src: 1. Purchasing pays invoices; procurement decides what to buy, from whom, and on what terms — judged on total cost of ownership, not sticker price.
segments.tr: 1. الشراء يدفع الفواتير، أما إدارة المشتريات فتقرر ما يُشترى، ومن أين، وبأي شروط، وتُقاس بإجمالي تكلفة الملكية لا بسعر الملصق.

segments.src: 2. Segment your spend (Kraljic: non-critical, leverage, bottleneck, strategic) and match your effort to the quadrant, because uniform effort wastes it.
segments.tr: 2. قسّم إنفاقك (كرالجيك: غير حرج، رافعة، نقطة اختناق، استراتيجي) وطابق جهدك مع الربع، لأن الجهد الموحّد يُهدر.

segments.src: 3. Outsourcing converts execution risk into supplier risk, so SRM — scorecards, segmentation, real relationships — is what keeps the savings from turning into an outage.
segments.tr: 3. الإسناد الخارجي يحوّل مخاطر التنفيذ إلى مخاطر على المورد، ولذلك فإن إدارة علاقات الموردين (بطاقات التقييم، والتقسيم، والعلاقات الحقيقية) هي ما يمنع تحول التوفير إلى توقف عن العمل.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ اختبار ذاتي

segments.src: **1.** A component costs very little each year, but only one certified supplier in the world makes it and a stoppage would halt your line.
segments.tr: **1.** مكوّن تكلفته قليلة كل عام، لكن مورداً معتمداً واحداً فقط في العالم يصنعه، وتوقفه سيوقف خطك الإنتاجي.

segments.src: In the Kraljic matrix, this is:
segments.tr: في مصفوفة كرالجيك، يُصنّف هذا ضمن:

segments.src: - (A) Non-critical
segments.tr: - (A) غير حرج

segments.src: - (B) Leverage
segments.tr: - (B) الرافعة

segments.src: - (C) Bottleneck
segments.tr: - (C) نقطة الاختناق

segments.src: - (D) Strategic
segments.tr: - (D) استراتيجي

segments.src: **2.** True or False: A company with a 4% net profit margin that cuts $100,000 from its purchasing costs achieves the same profit impact as generating $100,000 in additional sales.
segments.tr: **2.** صح أم خطأ: شركة هامش صافي ربحها 4% وتخفض 100,000 دولار من تكاليف مشترياتها، تحقق الأثر نفسه على الربح الذي تحققه بتوليد 100,000 دولار من مبيعات إضافية.

segments.src: **3.** Which of these is the best description of Total Cost of Ownership?
segments.tr: **3.** أيٌّ من هذه العبارات هو أفضل وصف لإجمالي تكلفة الملكية (TCO)؟

segments.src: - (A) The unit price plus sales tax
segments.tr: - (A) سعر الوحدة مضافاً إليه ضريبة المبيعات

segments.src: - (B) The purchase price plus all downstream costs of using that item, including freight, carrying cost, quality failures, and downtime
segments.tr: - (B) سعر الشراء مضافاً إليه جميع التكاليف اللاحقة لاستخدام هذا البند، بما في ذلك الشحن وتكلفة الاحتفاظ بالمخزون وإخفاقات الجودة وتوقف التشغيل

segments.src: - (C) The total dollar value of all purchase orders issued in a year
segments.tr: - (C) إجمالي قيمة جميع أوامر الشراء الصادرة خلال عام

segments.src: - (D) The supplier's manufacturing cost plus their profit margin
segments.tr: - (D) تكلفة تصنيع المورد مضافاً إليها هامش ربحه

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 مصطلحات اليوم

segments.src: - **Procurement** — The end-to-end process of identifying needs, sourcing and qualifying suppliers, contracting, buying, and managing supplier performance.
segments.tr: - **المشتريات (Procurement)**: العملية الشاملة لتحديد الاحتياجات، ومصادر الموردين وتأهيلهم، والتعاقد، والشراء، وإدارة أداء الموردين.

segments.src: - **Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)** — The full cost of acquiring and using a purchased item, including freight, inventory carrying, quality failures, downtime, and switching costs — not just the price.
segments.tr: - **إجمالي تكلفة الملكية (TCO)**: التكلفة الكاملة لاقتناء بند مشترى واستخدامه، وتشمل الشحن وتكلفة الاحتفاظ بالمخزون وإخفاقات الجودة وتوقف التشغيل وتكاليف التبديل، وليس السعر وحده.

segments.src: - **Kraljic Matrix** — A spend-segmentation framework plotting purchases by financial impact and supply risk into four quadrants (non-critical, leverage, bottleneck, strategic), each with its own sourcing strategy.
segments.tr: - **مصفوفة كرالجيك (Kraljic Matrix)**: إطار لتصنيف الإنفاق يرسم المشتريات وفق أثرها المالي ومخاطر التوريد في أربعة أرباع (غير حرج، رافعة، نقطة اختناق، استراتيجي)، ولكل ربع استراتيجية توريد خاصة به.

segments.src: - **Supplier Relationship Management (SRM)** — Segmenting the supply base and systematically managing performance and collaboration, concentrating attention on the suppliers that most affect the business.
segments.tr: - **إدارة علاقات الموردين (SRM)**: تقسيم قاعدة الموردين وإدارة أدائها والتعاون معها بشكل منهجي، مع تركيز الاهتمام على الموردين الأكثر تأثيراً في الأعمال.

segments.src: - **Profit-Leverage Effect** — The principle that a dollar saved in purchasing raises operating profit by roughly a full dollar, while a dollar of new sales raises it only by the margin rate.
segments.tr: - **أثر الرافعة على الربح (Profit-Leverage Effect)**: المبدأ القائل إن الدولار الموفّر في المشتريات يرفع الربح التشغيلي بما يقارب دولاراً كاملاً، بينما لا يرفعه الدولار من المبيعات الجديدة إلا بقدر هامش الربح.

segments.src: *Answers: **1 — (C) Bottleneck.** Low spend but high supply risk.
segments.tr: *الإجابات: **1 — (C) نقطة الاختناق.** إنفاق منخفض لكن مخاطر التوريد مرتفعة.

segments.src: The correct response isn't hard negotiation (there's no leverage at that volume) but risk mitigation: safety stock, a qualified second source, and a longer-term contract.*
segments.tr: الاستجابة الصحيحة ليست التفاوض الصارم (فلا توجد رافعة عند هذا الحجم)، بل تخفيف المخاطر: مخزون احتياطي للأمان، ومورد ثانٍ مؤهل، وعقد طويل الأجل.*

segments.src: ***2 — False.** It's dramatically better.
segments.tr: ***2 — خطأ.** بل العكس تماماً، فهو أفضل بكثير.

segments.src: At a 4% margin, $100,000 in additional sales yields about $4,000 of profit, while $100,000 in purchasing savings drops close to the full $100,000 to the bottom line — you'd need roughly $2.5 million in new sales to match it.
segments.tr: عند هامش 4%، تحقق 100,000 دولار من المبيعات الإضافية ربحاً قدره نحو 4,000 دولار، بينما يُضيف توفير 100,000 دولار في المشتريات ما يقارب المبلغ كاملاً إلى صافي الربح، وستحتاج إلى نحو 2.5 مليون دولار من المبيعات الجديدة لتعادله.

segments.src: That's the profit-leverage effect.*
segments.tr: هذا هو أثر الرافعة على الربح.*

segments.src: ***3 — (B).** TCO captures everything the item costs you over its life, not just the invoice.
segments.tr: ***3 — (B).** يشمل TCO كل ما يكلفك البند طوال عمره، لا الفاتورة وحدها.

segments.src: It's the reason the lowest bid frequently loses on a properly built evaluation.*
segments.tr: ولهذا غالباً ما يخسر أدنى عرض سعر في تقييم مُعدّ بشكل سليم.*

fr.title: [Logistique 101 n°6] Chaque dollar que vous ne dépensez pas est un dollar que vous n'avez pas besoin de gagner

segments.src: > Procurement is the discipline of deciding what to buy, who to buy it from, and how to keep that relationship working — and because purchased goods and services are the single largest line item in most companies, a dollar saved there lands on the profit line far faster than a dollar chased through sales.
segments.tr: > Les achats stratégiques sont la discipline qui consiste à décider quoi acheter, auprès de qui, et comment faire vivre cette relation dans la durée. Comme les biens et services achetés représentent le poste de dépense le plus important dans la plupart des entreprises, un dollar économisé à ce niveau atteint le résultat net bien plus vite qu'un dollar obtenu par les ventes.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Concept du jour

segments.src: Ask most people what a company does and they'll describe what it sells.
segments.tr: Demandez à la plupart des gens ce que fait une entreprise, et ils vous décriront ce qu'elle vend.

segments.src: But look at the income statement of almost any manufacturer, retailer, or restaurant group and you'll find the same thing: the biggest number isn't payroll or rent.
segments.tr: Mais regardez le compte de résultat de presque n'importe quel fabricant, distributeur ou groupe de restauration, et vous trouverez la même chose : le poste le plus élevé n'est ni la masse salariale ni le loyer.

segments.src: It's what the company **bought** — raw materials, components, packaging, freight, contract services.
segments.tr: C'est ce que l'entreprise **achète** : matières premières, composants, emballages, transport, prestations de services sous contrat.

segments.src: In many manufacturing firms, purchased goods and services eat more than half of every sales dollar.
segments.tr: Dans de nombreux industriels, les biens et services achetés absorbent plus de la moitié de chaque dollar de chiffre d'affaires.

segments.src: That's why procurement matters, and why it's the sixth stop in this series.
segments.tr: C'est pourquoi les achats comptent, et pourquoi ce sujet constitue la sixième étape de cette série.

segments.src: Here are the four ideas that hold it together.
segments.tr: Voici les quatre idées qui le structurent.

segments.src: Purchasing is a transaction.
segments.tr: Acheter est une transaction.

segments.src: Procurement is a strategy.**
segments.tr: Les achats stratégiques sont une stratégie.**

segments.src: Purchasing is the narrow act of issuing a purchase order and paying the invoice.
segments.tr: Acheter désigne l'acte précis d'émettre un bon de commande et de payer la facture.

segments.src: Procurement is the whole arc around it: figuring out what the business actually needs, deciding whether to make it in-house or buy it, finding and qualifying suppliers, negotiating terms, and managing performance for years afterward.
segments.tr: Les achats stratégiques englobent tout le processus autour : déterminer ce dont l'entreprise a réellement besoin, décider de fabriquer en interne ou d'acheter, trouver et qualifier les fournisseurs, négocier les conditions, puis piloter leurs performances pendant des années.

segments.src: Purchasing asks "what's the price?"
segments.tr: Acheter pose la question « quel est le prix ? »

segments.src: Procurement asks "what's the **total cost of ownership**?"
segments.tr: Les achats stratégiques posent la question « quel est le **coût total de possession** ? »

segments.src: Total Cost of Ownership = purchase price
segments.tr: Total Cost of Ownership = purchase price

segments.src: + freight and duties
segments.tr: + freight and duties

segments.src: + inventory carrying cost
segments.tr: + inventory carrying cost

segments.src: + inspection, scrap, and rework
segments.tr: + inspection, scrap, and rework

segments.src: + downtime and expediting
segments.tr: + downtime and expediting

segments.src: + switching or exit costs
segments.tr: + switching or exit costs

segments.src: A part that costs $9.20 instead of $10.00 is not cheaper if it fails inspection twice as often or ships from three weeks farther away.
segments.tr: Une pièce à 9,20 $ au lieu de 10,00 $ n'est pas moins chère si elle échoue au contrôle deux fois plus souvent, ou si elle vient de trois semaines de route en plus.

segments.src: Not every purchase deserves the same effort.**
segments.tr: Tous les achats ne méritent pas le même effort.**

segments.src: The standard tool here is the **Kraljic matrix**, which sorts everything you buy along two axes: how much money is involved, and how risky the supply is (few suppliers, fragile source, long lead time).
segments.tr: L'outil de référence ici est la **matrice de Kraljic**, qui classe tous vos achats selon deux axes : le montant en jeu et le risque d'approvisionnement (peu de fournisseurs, source fragile, délai long).

segments.src: That gives four quadrants, each with a different playbook:
segments.tr: On obtient quatre quadrants, chacun avec sa propre démarche :

segments.src: - **Non-critical** (low spend, low risk) — office supplies, cleaning goods. Automate it. Use a catalog, a P-card, and stop thinking about it.
segments.tr: - **Non critique** (faible dépense, faible risque) : fournitures de bureau, produits d'entretien. Automatisez avec un catalogue et une carte d'achat, et n'y pensez plus.

segments.src: - **Leverage** (high spend, low risk) — commodity packaging, standard fasteners. Many capable suppliers want your volume. Compete them, consolidate volume, negotiate hard.
segments.tr: - **Levier** (forte dépense, faible risque) : emballages standard, fixations courantes. Beaucoup de fournisseurs capables veulent votre volume. Mettez-les en concurrence, consolidez les volumes et négociez fermement.

segments.src: - **Bottleneck** (low spend, high risk) — a proprietary sensor, a single certified calibration lab. Small money, big pain if it stops. Hold safety stock, qualify a backup, sign a longer contract.
segments.tr: - **Goulot d'étranglement** (faible dépense, risque élevé) : un capteur propriétaire, un unique laboratoire d'étalonnage certifié. Petite somme, gros problème si cela s'arrête. Gardez un stock de sécurité, qualifiez un fournisseur de secours et signez un contrat plus long.

segments.src: - **Strategic** (high spend, high risk) — the engine, the chip, the signature ingredient. Few alternatives, enormous impact. Build a genuine partnership, share forecasts, invest in the relationship.
segments.tr: - **Stratégique** (forte dépense, risque élevé) : le moteur, la puce, l'ingrédient signature. Peu d'alternatives, impact considérable. Construisez un véritable partenariat, partagez les prévisions et investissez dans la relation.

segments.src: The mistake almost every under-resourced team makes is spending its best people on the wrong quadrant — running competitive bids on paper towels while the sole-source component nobody has a backup for quietly becomes an existential risk.
segments.tr: L'erreur que commet presque toute équipe sous-dotée est de mobiliser ses meilleurs éléments sur le mauvais quadrant : organiser des appels d'offres concurrentiels pour des essuie-tout pendant que le composant mono-source, sans aucune solution de rechange, devient discrètement un risque existentiel.

segments.src: Make-or-buy is a strategic choice, not a spreadsheet.**
segments.tr: Fabriquer ou acheter est un choix stratégique, pas un tableur.**

segments.src: Outsourcing tends to win on cost, flexibility, and access to specialized capability.
segments.tr: L'externalisation tend à gagner sur le coût, la flexibilité et l'accès à des compétences spécialisées.

segments.src: Keeping it in-house tends to win on control, quality assurance, IP protection, and responsiveness.
segments.tr: Le maintien en interne tend à gagner sur le contrôle, l'assurance qualité, la protection de la propriété intellectuelle et la réactivité.

segments.src: The durable rule of thumb: **outsource what is not your core competency, and be extremely careful outsourcing anything a customer would notice.** The catch is that outsourcing doesn't remove risk — it converts execution risk into supplier risk.
segments.tr: La règle empirique durable : **externalisez ce qui n'est pas votre compétence cœur, et soyez extrêmement prudent avec tout ce que le client remarquerait.** Le piège est que l'externalisation ne supprime pas le risque, elle le transforme en risque fournisseur.

segments.src: Boeing's 787 program is the textbook case: an aggressive outsourcing model spread design and fabrication across a deep global supplier tier, and the resulting integration and coordination problems contributed to years of delay.
segments.tr: Le programme 787 de Boeing en est le cas d'école : un modèle d'externalisation agressif a réparti la conception et la fabrication sur une chaîne mondiale de fournisseurs, et les problèmes d'intégration et de coordination qui en ont résulté ont contribué à plusieurs années de retard.

segments.src: Contracts don't manage relationships.
segments.tr: Les contrats ne gèrent pas les relations.

segments.src: People do.**
segments.tr: Ce sont les personnes qui le font.**

segments.src: **Supplier Relationship Management (SRM)** is the practice of segmenting suppliers, scoring them on real metrics, and investing management attention where it pays off.
segments.tr: La **gestion de la relation fournisseurs (SRM)** consiste à segmenter les fournisseurs, à les évaluer sur des indicateurs réels et à consacrer l'attention managériale là où elle rapporte.

segments.src: A typical scorecard runs on **QCDS** — quality (defect rate, PPM), cost (price trend, cost-reduction ideas), delivery (on-time-in-full percentage), and service (responsiveness, technical support).
segments.tr: Une grille d'évaluation type repose sur le **QCDS** : qualité (taux de défauts, PPM), coût (évolution des prix, idées de réduction de coûts), délai (taux de livraison complète et à l'heure) et service (réactivité, support technique).

segments.src: You cannot run a deep partnership with 4,000 suppliers, and you shouldn't try.
segments.tr: On ne peut pas entretenir un partenariat approfondi avec 4 000 fournisseurs, et il ne faut pas essayer.

segments.src: You run transactional discipline with most of them, preferred-supplier terms with a couple hundred, and true joint development with the handful that determine whether your product is any good.
segments.tr: On applique une rigueur transactionnelle à la plupart d'entre eux, des conditions de fournisseur privilégié à quelques centaines, et un véritable co-développement avec la poignée de fournisseurs qui déterminent la qualité de votre produit.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dans la vie quotidienne

segments.src: Say you run **Trailhead Coffee**, a nine-location café chain in Austin.
segments.tr: Supposons que vous dirigiez **Trailhead Coffee**, une chaîne de cafés de neuf points de vente à Austin.

segments.src: Annual revenue is $6.2 million, net margin about 5%, and roughly $2.4 million a year goes out the door to suppliers.
segments.tr: Le chiffre d'affaires annuel est de 6,2 millions de dollars, la marge nette d'environ 5 %, et environ 2,4 millions de dollars partent chaque année vers les fournisseurs.

segments.src: Your buying list sorts itself into the quadrants almost immediately.
segments.tr: Votre liste d'achats se répartit presque immédiatement entre les quadrants.

segments.src: **Green coffee beans — strategic.** Around $520,000 a year, and your entire brand rests on it.
segments.tr: **Grains de café verts : stratégique.** Environ 520 000 dollars par an, et toute votre marque repose dessus.

segments.src: There is no interchangeable substitute; customers can taste a switch.
segments.tr: Il n'existe pas de substitut interchangeable ; les clients sentent la différence au moindre changement.

segments.src: So you don't run this on an annual bid.
segments.tr: Vous ne gérez donc pas cela par un appel d'offres annuel.

segments.src: You sign a multi-year agreement with your Chiapas importer, visit the co-op, share your growth forecast so they can plan their crop, and accept that you'll pay a little more for consistency and first call on the good lots.
segments.tr: Vous signez un accord pluriannuel avec votre importateur du Chiapas, vous visitez la coopérative, vous partagez vos prévisions de croissance pour qu'elle puisse planifier sa récolte, et vous acceptez de payer un peu plus pour la constance et la priorité sur les meilleurs lots.

segments.src: **Cups, lids, and sleeves — leverage.** About $310,000 a year, and a dozen distributors in Texas would love the business.
segments.tr: **Gobelets, couvercles et manchons : levier.** Environ 310 000 dollars par an, et une douzaine de distributeurs au Texas seraient ravis d'avoir ce marché.

segments.src: This is where a competitive RFQ pays.
segments.tr: C'est là qu'une consultation concurrentielle (RFQ) est payante.

segments.src: You consolidate all nine stores onto one contract instead of letting each manager order locally, and you land 9% off — roughly $28,000.
segments.tr: Vous regroupez les neuf magasins sur un seul contrat au lieu de laisser chaque responsable commander localement, et vous obtenez 9 % de réduction, soit environ 28 000 dollars.

segments.src: **Espresso machine service — bottleneck.** Maybe $18,000 a year.
segments.tr: **Maintenance des machines à espresso : goulot d'étranglement.** Peut-être 18 000 dollars par an.

segments.src: Trivial money.
segments.tr: Une somme dérisoire.

segments.src: But exactly one certified tech in the metro services your machines, and if a grouphead fails on a Saturday at your busiest store, you lose $2,800 in a day.
segments.tr: Mais il existe exactement un technicien certifié dans la métropole qui entretient vos machines, et si une tête de groupe tombe en panne un samedi dans votre magasin le plus fréquenté, vous perdez 2 800 dollars en une journée.

segments.src: So you pay for a service contract with a guaranteed four-hour response, and you keep a spare set of critical parts on the shelf.
segments.tr: Vous payez donc un contrat de maintenance garantissant une intervention sous quatre heures, et vous gardez un jeu de pièces critiques en rayon.

segments.src: Small spend, deliberate attention.
segments.tr: Petite dépense, attention délibérée.

segments.src: **Office and cleaning supplies — non-critical.** Around $40,000.
segments.tr: **Fournitures de bureau et d'entretien : non critique.** Environ 40 000 dollars.

segments.src: Put it on a punch-out catalog with one distributor, give managers a spending limit, and never hold a meeting about it again.
segments.tr: Placez-les sur un catalogue en ligne avec un seul distributeur, fixez un plafond de dépense aux responsables, et ne tenez plus jamais de réunion à ce sujet.

segments.src: Now the part that makes the CFO sit up.
segments.tr: Voici maintenant la partie qui fait réagir le directeur financier.

segments.src: That $28,000 saved on cups is $28,000 of pure operating profit.
segments.tr: Les 28 000 dollars économisés sur les gobelets sont 28 000 dollars de bénéfice d'exploitation pur.

segments.src: To generate the same $28,000 through sales at a 5% net margin, you'd have to sell **$560,000** more coffee — roughly a tenth of the entire business.
segments.tr: Pour générer la même somme par les ventes avec une marge nette de 5 %, il faudrait vendre **560 000 dollars** de café supplémentaires, soit environ un dixième de l'ensemble de l'activité.

segments.src: That's the **profit-leverage effect**, and it's why procurement is one of the highest-return functions in a company that nobody outside the building ever thinks about.
segments.tr: C'est l'**effet de levier sur le résultat**, et c'est pourquoi les achats comptent parmi les fonctions au rendement le plus élevé d'une entreprise, alors que personne en dehors du bâtiment n'y pense jamais.

segments.src: The catch: chase that saving into the wrong quadrant — switch to a cheaper green coffee supplier to save $30,000 — and you may lose regulars who never tell you why they stopped coming.
segments.tr: Le piège : poursuivre cette économie dans le mauvais quadrant, par exemple passer à un fournisseur de café vert moins cher pour économiser 30 000 dollars, et vous risquez de perdre des clients fidèles qui ne vous diront jamais pourquoi ils ont cessé de venir.

segments.src: Savings that damage the product aren't savings.
segments.tr: Les économies qui abîment le produit ne sont pas des économies.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Récapitulatif en 3 lignes

segments.src: 1. Purchasing pays invoices; procurement decides what to buy, from whom, and on what terms — judged on total cost of ownership, not sticker price.
segments.tr: 1. Les achats paient les factures ; les achats stratégiques décident quoi acheter, auprès de qui et à quelles conditions, et jugent sur le coût total de possession, pas sur le prix affiché.

segments.src: 2. Segment your spend (Kraljic: non-critical, leverage, bottleneck, strategic) and match your effort to the quadrant, because uniform effort wastes it.
segments.tr: 2. Segmentez vos dépenses (Kraljic : non critique, levier, goulot d'étranglement, stratégique) et adaptez votre effort au quadrant, car un effort uniforme est gaspillé.

segments.src: 3. Outsourcing converts execution risk into supplier risk, so SRM — scorecards, segmentation, real relationships — is what keeps the savings from turning into an outage.
segments.tr: 3. L'externalisation transforme le risque d'exécution en risque fournisseur. C'est pourquoi la gestion de la relation fournisseurs (grilles d'évaluation, segmentation, relations réelles) empêche les économies de se transformer en rupture.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ Auto-évaluation

segments.src: **1.** A component costs very little each year, but only one certified supplier in the world makes it and a stoppage would halt your line.
segments.tr: **1.** Un composant coûte très peu chaque année, mais un seul fournisseur certifié au monde le fabrique, et un arrêt bloquerait votre ligne.

segments.src: In the Kraljic matrix, this is:
segments.tr: Dans la matrice de Kraljic, il s'agit de :

segments.src: - (A) Non-critical
segments.tr: - (A) Non critique

segments.src: - (B) Leverage
segments.tr: - (B) Levier

segments.src: - (C) Bottleneck
segments.tr: - (C) Goulot d'étranglement

segments.src: - (D) Strategic
segments.tr: - (D) Stratégique

segments.src: **2.** True or False: A company with a 4% net profit margin that cuts $100,000 from its purchasing costs achieves the same profit impact as generating $100,000 in additional sales.
segments.tr: **2.** Vrai ou faux : une entreprise avec une marge nette de 4 % qui réduit ses achats de 100 000 dollars obtient le même impact sur le résultat que si elle générait 100 000 dollars de ventes supplémentaires.

segments.src: **3.** Which of these is the best description of Total Cost of Ownership?
segments.tr: **3.** Laquelle de ces définitions décrit le mieux le coût total de possession (TCO) ?

segments.src: - (A) The unit price plus sales tax
segments.tr: - (A) Le prix unitaire plus la TVA

segments.src: - (B) The purchase price plus all downstream costs of using that item, including freight, carrying cost, quality failures, and downtime
segments.tr: - (B) Le prix d'achat plus tous les coûts aval liés à l'utilisation de l'article, y compris le transport, le coût de stockage, les défaillances de qualité et les temps d'arrêt

segments.src: - (C) The total dollar value of all purchase orders issued in a year
segments.tr: - (C) La valeur totale en dollars de tous les bons de commande émis dans l'année

segments.src: - (D) The supplier's manufacturing cost plus their profit margin
segments.tr: - (D) Le coût de fabrication du fournisseur plus sa marge bénéficiaire

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Termes du jour

segments.src: - **Procurement** — The end-to-end process of identifying needs, sourcing and qualifying suppliers, contracting, buying, and managing supplier performance.
segments.tr: - **Achats stratégiques (Procurement)** : processus de bout en bout consistant à identifier les besoins, sourcer et qualifier les fournisseurs, contractualiser, acheter et piloter les performances des fournisseurs.

segments.src: - **Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)** — The full cost of acquiring and using a purchased item, including freight, inventory carrying, quality failures, downtime, and switching costs — not just the price.
segments.tr: - **Coût total de possession (TCO)** : coût complet d'acquisition et d'utilisation d'un article acheté, incluant le transport, le stockage, les défaillances de qualité, les temps d'arrêt et les coûts de changement de fournisseur, et pas seulement le prix.

segments.src: - **Kraljic Matrix** — A spend-segmentation framework plotting purchases by financial impact and supply risk into four quadrants (non-critical, leverage, bottleneck, strategic), each with its own sourcing strategy.
segments.tr: - **Matrice de Kraljic** : cadre de segmentation des dépenses qui positionne les achats selon leur impact financier et leur risque d'approvisionnement en quatre quadrants (non critique, levier, goulot d'étranglement, stratégique), chacun avec sa propre stratégie d'achat.

segments.src: - **Supplier Relationship Management (SRM)** — Segmenting the supply base and systematically managing performance and collaboration, concentrating attention on the suppliers that most affect the business.
segments.tr: - **Gestion de la relation fournisseurs (SRM)** : segmentation de la base fournisseurs et pilotage systématique des performances et de la collaboration, en concentrant l'attention sur les fournisseurs qui affectent le plus l'activité.

segments.src: - **Profit-Leverage Effect** — The principle that a dollar saved in purchasing raises operating profit by roughly a full dollar, while a dollar of new sales raises it only by the margin rate.
segments.tr: - **Effet de levier sur le résultat (Profit-Leverage Effect)** : principe selon lequel un dollar économisé à l'achat augmente le résultat d'exploitation d'à peu près un dollar entier, alors qu'un dollar de ventes supplémentaires ne l'augmente que du taux de marge.

segments.src: *Answers: **1 — (C) Bottleneck.** Low spend but high supply risk.
segments.tr: *Réponses : **1 — (C) Goulot d'étranglement.** Faible dépense, mais risque d'approvisionnement élevé.

segments.src: The correct response isn't hard negotiation (there's no leverage at that volume) but risk mitigation: safety stock, a qualified second source, and a longer-term contract.*
segments.tr: La bonne réponse n'est pas la négociation dure (il n'existe aucun levier à ce volume) mais la maîtrise du risque : stock de sécurité, second fournisseur qualifié et contrat à plus long terme.*

segments.src: ***2 — False.** It's dramatically better.
segments.tr: ***2 — Faux.** C'est bien mieux que cela.

segments.src: At a 4% margin, $100,000 in additional sales yields about $4,000 of profit, while $100,000 in purchasing savings drops close to the full $100,000 to the bottom line — you'd need roughly $2.5 million in new sales to match it.
segments.tr: À une marge de 4 %, 100 000 dollars de ventes supplémentaires rapportent environ 4 000 dollars de bénéfice, alors que 100 000 dollars d'économies d'achat se retrouvent presque intégralement dans le résultat, soit près de 100 000 dollars. Il faudrait environ 2,5 millions de dollars de ventes nouvelles pour égaler cet effet.

segments.src: That's the profit-leverage effect.*
segments.tr: C'est l'effet de levier sur le résultat.*

segments.src: ***3 — (B).** TCO captures everything the item costs you over its life, not just the invoice.
segments.tr: ***3 — (B).** Le TCO prend en compte tout ce que l'article vous coûte sur sa durée de vie, et pas seulement la facture.

segments.src: It's the reason the lowest bid frequently loses on a properly built evaluation.*
segments.tr: C'est la raison pour laquelle l'offre la moins chère perd souvent lors d'une évaluation bien construite.*

pt.title: [Logistics 101 #6] Cada real que você não gasta é um real que você não precisa ganhar

segments.src: > Procurement is the discipline of deciding what to buy, who to buy it from, and how to keep that relationship working — and because purchased goods and services are the single largest line item in most companies, a dollar saved there lands on the profit line far faster than a dollar chased through sales.
segments.tr: > A procurement é a disciplina de decidir o que comprar, de quem comprar e como manter essa relação funcionando. Como bens e serviços adquiridos são o maior item de custo da maioria das empresas, um real economizado aí chega à linha de lucro muito mais rápido do que um real conquistado por meio de vendas.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Conceito de Hoje

segments.src: Ask most people what a company does and they'll describe what it sells.
segments.tr: Pergunte à maioria das pessoas o que uma empresa faz e elas vão descrever o que ela vende.

segments.src: But look at the income statement of almost any manufacturer, retailer, or restaurant group and you'll find the same thing: the biggest number isn't payroll or rent.
segments.tr: Mas olhe a demonstração de resultados de praticamente qualquer fabricante, varejista ou rede de restaurantes e você encontrará a mesma coisa: o maior número não é a folha de pagamento nem o aluguel.

segments.src: It's what the company **bought** — raw materials, components, packaging, freight, contract services.
segments.tr: É o que a empresa **comprou**: matérias-primas, componentes, embalagens, frete, serviços contratados.

segments.src: In many manufacturing firms, purchased goods and services eat more than half of every sales dollar.
segments.tr: Em muitas empresas industriais, bens e serviços comprados consomem mais da metade de cada real de vendas.

segments.src: That's why procurement matters, and why it's the sixth stop in this series.
segments.tr: É por isso que a procurement importa, e é por isso que ela é a sexta parada desta série.

segments.src: Here are the four ideas that hold it together.
segments.tr: Aqui estão as quatro ideias que a sustentam.

segments.src: Purchasing is a transaction.
segments.tr: Compra é uma transação.

segments.src: Procurement is a strategy.**
segments.tr: Procurement é estratégia.**

segments.src: Purchasing is the narrow act of issuing a purchase order and paying the invoice.
segments.tr: Purchasing é o ato restrito de emitir um pedido de compra e pagar a nota fiscal.

segments.src: Procurement is the whole arc around it: figuring out what the business actually needs, deciding whether to make it in-house or buy it, finding and qualifying suppliers, negotiating terms, and managing performance for years afterward.
segments.tr: Procurement é todo o ciclo ao redor disso: entender o que o negócio realmente precisa, decidir se fabrica internamente ou compra, encontrar e qualificar fornecedores, negociar condições e gerenciar o desempenho por anos depois.

segments.tr: Compras pergunta "qual é o preço?"

segments.src: Procurement asks "what's the **total cost of ownership**?"
segments.tr: Procurement pergunta "qual é o **custo total de propriedade**?"

segments.tr: + freight and duties

segments.tr: + downtime and expediting

segments.tr: + switching or exit costs

segments.src: Not every purchase deserves the same effort.**
segments.tr: Nem toda compra merece o mesmo esforço.**

segments.src: The standard tool here is the **Kraljic matrix**, which sorts everything you buy along two axes: how much money is involved, and how risky the supply is (few suppliers, fragile source, long lead time).
segments.tr: A ferramenta padrão aqui é a **matriz de Kraljic**, que classifica tudo o que você compra em dois eixos: quanto dinheiro está envolvido e quão arriscado é o fornecimento (poucos fornecedores, fonte frágil, prazo de entrega longo).

segments.src: That gives four quadrants, each with a different playbook:
segments.tr: Isso gera quatro quadrantes, cada um com um roteiro diferente:

segments.src: - **Non-critical** (low spend, low risk) — office supplies, cleaning goods. Automate it. Use a catalog, a P-card, and stop thinking about it.
segments.tr: - **Não crítico** (baixo gasto, baixo risco): material de escritório, produtos de limpeza. Automatize. Use um catálogo, um cartão corporativo e pare de pensar nisso.

segments.src: - **Leverage** (high spend, low risk) — commodity packaging, standard fasteners. Many capable suppliers want your volume. Compete them, consolidate volume, negotiate hard.
segments.tr: - **Alavancagem** (alto gasto, baixo risco): embalagens commodity, fixadores padrão. Muitos fornecedores capazes querem o seu volume. Faça-os competir, consolide o volume e negocie com firmeza.

segments.src: - **Bottleneck** (low spend, high risk) — a proprietary sensor, a single certified calibration lab. Small money, big pain if it stops. Hold safety stock, qualify a backup, sign a longer contract.
segments.tr: - **Gargalo** (baixo gasto, alto risco): um sensor proprietário, um único laboratório de calibração certificado. Pouco dinheiro, mas grande dor de cabeça se parar. Mantenha estoque de segurança, qualifique um fornecedor reserva e assine um contrato mais longo.

segments.src: - **Strategic** (high spend, high risk) — the engine, the chip, the signature ingredient. Few alternatives, enormous impact. Build a genuine partnership, share forecasts, invest in the relationship.
segments.tr: - **Estratégico** (alto gasto, alto risco): o motor, o chip, o ingrediente-assinatura. Poucas alternativas, impacto enorme. Construa uma parceria genuína, compartilhe previsões e invista na relação.

segments.src: The mistake almost every under-resourced team makes is spending its best people on the wrong quadrant — running competitive bids on paper towels while the sole-source component nobody has a backup for quietly becomes an existential risk.
segments.tr: O erro que quase toda equipe com poucos recursos comete é gastar suas melhores pessoas no quadrante errado: fazer licitações competitivas para toalhas de papel enquanto o componente de fornecedor único, para o qual ninguém tem reserva, silenciosamente se torna um risco existencial.

segments.src: Make-or-buy is a strategic choice, not a spreadsheet.**
segments.tr: Fabricar ou comprar é uma escolha estratégica, não uma planilha.**

segments.src: Outsourcing tends to win on cost, flexibility, and access to specialized capability.
segments.tr: Terceirizar tende a ganhar em custo, flexibilidade e acesso a capacidade especializada.

segments.src: Keeping it in-house tends to win on control, quality assurance, IP protection, and responsiveness.
segments.tr: Manter internamente tende a ganhar em controle, garantia de qualidade, proteção de propriedade intelectual e capacidade de resposta.

segments.src: The durable rule of thumb: **outsource what is not your core competency, and be extremely careful outsourcing anything a customer would notice.** The catch is that outsourcing doesn't remove risk — it converts execution risk into supplier risk.
segments.tr: A regra prática duradoura: **terceirize o que não é sua competência central, e tenha muito cuidado ao terceirizar qualquer coisa que o cliente perceberia.** O problema é que terceirizar não elimina o risco; ele transforma o risco de execução em risco de fornecedor.

segments.src: Boeing's 787 program is the textbook case: an aggressive outsourcing model spread design and fabrication across a deep global supplier tier, and the resulting integration and coordination problems contributed to years of delay.
segments.tr: O programa 787 da Boeing é o caso clássico: um modelo de terceirização agressivo espalhou o projeto e a fabricação por uma cadeia global profunda de fornecedores, e os problemas de integração e coordenação resultantes contribuíram para anos de atraso.

segments.src: Contracts don't manage relationships.
segments.tr: Contratos não gerenciam relacionamentos.

segments.src: People do.**
segments.tr: Pessoas gerenciam.**

segments.src: **Supplier Relationship Management (SRM)** is the practice of segmenting suppliers, scoring them on real metrics, and investing management attention where it pays off.
segments.tr: A **Gestão de Relacionamento com Fornecedores (SRM)** é a prática de segmentar fornecedores, avaliá-los com métricas reais e investir atenção gerencial onde ela compensa.

segments.src: A typical scorecard runs on **QCDS** — quality (defect rate, PPM), cost (price trend, cost-reduction ideas), delivery (on-time-in-full percentage), and service (responsiveness, technical support).
segments.tr: Um scorecard típico roda sobre o **QCDS**: qualidade (taxa de defeitos, PPM), custo (tendência de preço, ideias de redução de custo), entrega (percentual de entregas no prazo e completas) e serviço (capacidade de resposta, suporte técnico).

segments.src: You cannot run a deep partnership with 4,000 suppliers, and you shouldn't try.
segments.tr: Você não consegue manter uma parceria profunda com 4.000 fornecedores, e não deve tentar.

segments.src: You run transactional discipline with most of them, preferred-supplier terms with a couple hundred, and true joint development with the handful that determine whether your product is any good.
segments.tr: Você mantém disciplina transacional com a maioria, termos de fornecedor preferencial com algumas centenas e desenvolvimento conjunto real com os poucos que determinam se o seu produto é bom.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## No Dia a Dia

segments.src: Say you run **Trailhead Coffee**, a nine-location café chain in Austin.
segments.tr: Imagine que você administra a **Trailhead Coffee**, uma rede de cafés com nove unidades em Austin.

segments.src: Annual revenue is $6.2 million, net margin about 5%, and roughly $2.4 million a year goes out the door to suppliers.
segments.tr: A receita anual é de $6.2 milhões, a margem líquida é de cerca de 5%, e aproximadamente $2.4 milhões por ano saem para fornecedores.

segments.src: Your buying list sorts itself into the quadrants almost immediately.
segments.tr: Sua lista de compras se organiza sozinha nos quadrantes quase imediatamente.

segments.src: **Green coffee beans — strategic.** Around $520,000 a year, and your entire brand rests on it.
segments.tr: **Grãos de café verde: estratégico.** Cerca de $520,000 por ano, e toda a sua marca depende disso.

segments.src: There is no interchangeable substitute; customers can taste a switch.
segments.tr: Não há substituto intercambiável; os clientes percebem a troca no sabor.

segments.src: So you don't run this on an annual bid.
segments.tr: Por isso, você não administra isso com uma licitação anual.

segments.src: You sign a multi-year agreement with your Chiapas importer, visit the co-op, share your growth forecast so they can plan their crop, and accept that you'll pay a little more for consistency and first call on the good lots.
segments.tr: Você assina um contrato plurianual com seu importador de Chiapas, visita a cooperativa, compartilha sua previsão de crescimento para que possam planejar a safra e aceita pagar um pouco mais pela consistência e pela prioridade nos bons lotes.

segments.src: **Cups, lids, and sleeves — leverage.** About $310,000 a year, and a dozen distributors in Texas would love the business.
segments.tr: **Copos, tampas e mangas: alavancagem.** Cerca de $310,000 por ano, e uma dúzia de distribuidores no Texas adoraria o negócio.

segments.src: This is where a competitive RFQ pays.
segments.tr: É aqui que uma RFQ competitiva compensa.

segments.src: You consolidate all nine stores onto one contract instead of letting each manager order locally, and you land 9% off — roughly $28,000.
segments.tr: Você consolida as nove lojas em um único contrato, em vez de deixar cada gerente pedir localmente, e consegue 9% de desconto, cerca de $28,000.

segments.src: **Espresso machine service — bottleneck.** Maybe $18,000 a year.
segments.tr: **Manutenção da máquina de espresso: gargalo.** Talvez $18,000 por ano.

segments.src: Trivial money.
segments.tr: Dinheiro irrelevante.

segments.src: But exactly one certified tech in the metro services your machines, and if a grouphead fails on a Saturday at your busiest store, you lose $2,800 in a day.
segments.tr: Mas existe exatamente um técnico certificado na região que atende suas máquinas, e se um grupo falhar num sábado na sua loja mais movimentada, você perde $2,800 em um dia.

segments.src: So you pay for a service contract with a guaranteed four-hour response, and you keep a spare set of critical parts on the shelf.
segments.tr: Por isso, você paga um contrato de serviço com resposta garantida em quatro horas e mantém um conjunto reserva de peças críticas na prateleira.

segments.src: Small spend, deliberate attention.
segments.tr: Gasto pequeno, atenção deliberada.

segments.src: **Office and cleaning supplies — non-critical.** Around $40,000.
segments.tr: **Material de escritório e limpeza: não crítico.** Cerca de $40,000.

segments.src: Put it on a punch-out catalog with one distributor, give managers a spending limit, and never hold a meeting about it again.
segments.tr: Coloque em um catálogo de compra direta com um distribuidor, dê aos gerentes um limite de gasto e nunca mais faça uma reunião sobre isso.

segments.src: Now the part that makes the CFO sit up.
segments.tr: Agora, a parte que faz o CFO se endireitar na cadeira.

segments.src: That $28,000 saved on cups is $28,000 of pure operating profit.
segments.tr: Os $28,000 economizados em copos são $28,000 de lucro operacional puro.

segments.src: To generate the same $28,000 through sales at a 5% net margin, you'd have to sell **$560,000** more coffee — roughly a tenth of the entire business.
segments.tr: Para gerar os mesmos $28,000 em vendas com margem líquida de 5%, você precisaria vender **$560,000** a mais em café, cerca de um décimo de todo o negócio.

segments.src: That's the **profit-leverage effect**, and it's why procurement is one of the highest-return functions in a company that nobody outside the building ever thinks about.
segments.tr: Esse é o **efeito alavancagem do lucro**, e é por isso que a procurement é uma das funções de maior retorno em uma empresa, algo em que ninguém de fora do prédio jamais pensa.

segments.src: The catch: chase that saving into the wrong quadrant — switch to a cheaper green coffee supplier to save $30,000 — and you may lose regulars who never tell you why they stopped coming.
segments.tr: A armadilha: persiga essa economia no quadrante errado (trocar para um fornecedor de café verde mais barato para economizar $30,000) e você pode perder clientes fiéis que nunca dirão por que deixaram de vir.

segments.src: Savings that damage the product aren't savings.
segments.tr: Economias que prejudicam o produto não são economias.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Resumo em 3 Linhas

segments.src: 1. Purchasing pays invoices; procurement decides what to buy, from whom, and on what terms — judged on total cost of ownership, not sticker price.
segments.tr: 1. Compras paga notas fiscais; a procurement decide o que comprar, de quem e em quais condições, avaliada pelo custo total de propriedade, não pelo preço de etiqueta.

segments.src: 2. Segment your spend (Kraljic: non-critical, leverage, bottleneck, strategic) and match your effort to the quadrant, because uniform effort wastes it.
segments.tr: 2. Segmente seus gastos (Kraljic: não crítico, alavancagem, gargalo, estratégico) e ajuste o esforço ao quadrante, porque um esforço uniforme desperdiça recursos.

segments.src: 3. Outsourcing converts execution risk into supplier risk, so SRM — scorecards, segmentation, real relationships — is what keeps the savings from turning into an outage.
segments.tr: 3. Terceirizar transforma risco de execução em risco de fornecedor, então o SRM (scorecards, segmentação, relacionamentos reais) é o que impede que a economia vire uma parada.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ Autoavaliação

segments.src: **1.** A component costs very little each year, but only one certified supplier in the world makes it and a stoppage would halt your line.
segments.tr: **1.** Um componente custa muito pouco por ano, mas apenas um fornecedor certificado no mundo o fabrica, e uma interrupção pararia sua linha.

segments.src: In the Kraljic matrix, this is:
segments.tr: Na matriz de Kraljic, isso é:

segments.src: - (A) Non-critical
segments.tr: - (A) Não crítico

segments.src: - (B) Leverage
segments.tr: - (B) Alavancagem

segments.src: - (C) Bottleneck
segments.tr: - (C) Gargalo

segments.src: - (D) Strategic
segments.tr: - (D) Estratégico

segments.src: **2.** True or False: A company with a 4% net profit margin that cuts $100,000 from its purchasing costs achieves the same profit impact as generating $100,000 in additional sales.
segments.tr: **2.** Verdadeiro ou falso: uma empresa com margem líquida de 4% que corta $100,000 dos custos de compra obtém o mesmo impacto no lucro que gerar $100,000 em vendas adicionais.

segments.src: **3.** Which of these is the best description of Total Cost of Ownership?
segments.tr: **3.** Qual destas é a melhor descrição de Custo Total de Propriedade?

segments.src: - (A) The unit price plus sales tax
segments.tr: - (A) O preço unitário mais o imposto sobre vendas

segments.src: - (B) The purchase price plus all downstream costs of using that item, including freight, carrying cost, quality failures, and downtime
segments.tr: - (B) O preço de compra mais todos os custos posteriores de uso do item, incluindo frete, custo de manutenção de estoque, falhas de qualidade e tempo parado

segments.src: - (C) The total dollar value of all purchase orders issued in a year
segments.tr: - (C) O valor total em dólares de todos os pedidos de compra emitidos em um ano

segments.src: - (D) The supplier's manufacturing cost plus their profit margin
segments.tr: - (D) O custo de fabricação do fornecedor mais a margem de lucro dele

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Termos de Hoje

segments.src: - **Procurement** — The end-to-end process of identifying needs, sourcing and qualifying suppliers, contracting, buying, and managing supplier performance.
segments.tr: - **Procurement**: o processo completo de identificar necessidades, buscar e qualificar fornecedores, contratar, comprar e gerenciar o desempenho dos fornecedores.

segments.src: - **Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)** — The full cost of acquiring and using a purchased item, including freight, inventory carrying, quality failures, downtime, and switching costs — not just the price.
segments.tr: - **Custo Total de Propriedade (TCO)**: o custo completo de adquirir e usar um item comprado, incluindo frete, manutenção de estoque, falhas de qualidade, tempo parado e custos de troca, não apenas o preço.

segments.src: - **Kraljic Matrix** — A spend-segmentation framework plotting purchases by financial impact and supply risk into four quadrants (non-critical, leverage, bottleneck, strategic), each with its own sourcing strategy.
segments.tr: - **Matriz de Kraljic**: uma estrutura de segmentação de gastos que posiciona as compras por impacto financeiro e risco de fornecimento em quatro quadrantes (não crítico, alavancagem, gargalo, estratégico), cada um com sua própria estratégia de sourcing.

segments.src: - **Supplier Relationship Management (SRM)** — Segmenting the supply base and systematically managing performance and collaboration, concentrating attention on the suppliers that most affect the business.
segments.tr: - **Gestão de Relacionamento com Fornecedores (SRM)**: segmentar a base de fornecedores e gerenciar sistematicamente o desempenho e a colaboração, concentrando a atenção nos fornecedores que mais afetam o negócio.

segments.src: - **Profit-Leverage Effect** — The principle that a dollar saved in purchasing raises operating profit by roughly a full dollar, while a dollar of new sales raises it only by the margin rate.
segments.tr: - **Efeito Alavancagem do Lucro**: o princípio de que um real economizado em compras aumenta o lucro operacional em aproximadamente um real inteiro, enquanto um real de novas vendas o aumenta apenas pela taxa de margem.

segments.src: *Answers: **1 — (C) Bottleneck.** Low spend but high supply risk.
segments.tr: *Respostas: **1 — (C) Gargalo.** Gasto baixo, mas alto risco de fornecimento.

segments.src: The correct response isn't hard negotiation (there's no leverage at that volume) but risk mitigation: safety stock, a qualified second source, and a longer-term contract.*
segments.tr: A resposta correta não é negociação dura (não há alavancagem nesse volume), e sim mitigação de risco: estoque de segurança, uma segunda fonte qualificada e um contrato de prazo mais longo.*

segments.src: ***2 — False.** It's dramatically better.
segments.tr: ***2 — Falso.** É muito melhor.

segments.src: At a 4% margin, $100,000 in additional sales yields about $4,000 of profit, while $100,000 in purchasing savings drops close to the full $100,000 to the bottom line — you'd need roughly $2.5 million in new sales to match it.
segments.tr: Com margem de 4%, $100,000 em vendas adicionais geram cerca de $4,000 de lucro, enquanto $100,000 em economia de compras caem quase inteiros no resultado: você precisaria de cerca de $2.5 milhões em novas vendas para igualar isso.

segments.src: That's the profit-leverage effect.*
segments.tr: Esse é o efeito alavancagem do lucro.*

segments.src: ***3 — (B).** TCO captures everything the item costs you over its life, not just the invoice.
segments.tr: ***3 — (B).** O TCO inclui tudo o que o item custa ao longo da sua vida útil, não apenas a nota fiscal.

segments.src: It's the reason the lowest bid frequently loses on a properly built evaluation.*
segments.tr: É a razão pela qual a menor proposta frequentemente perde em uma avaliação bem construída.*

in.title: [Logistics 101 #6] Setiap Dolar yang Tidak Anda Belanjakan Adalah Dolar yang Tidak Perlu Anda Hasilkan

segments.src: > Procurement is the discipline of deciding what to buy, who to buy it from, and how to keep that relationship working — and because purchased goods and services are the single largest line item in most companies, a dollar saved there lands on the profit line far faster than a dollar chased through sales.
segments.tr: > Pengadaan adalah disiplin dalam memutuskan apa yang akan dibeli, dari siapa membelinya, dan bagaimana menjaga hubungan tersebut tetap berjalan. Karena barang dan jasa yang dibeli merupakan pos biaya terbesar di sebagian besar perusahaan, satu dolar yang dihemat di sini akan masuk ke laba jauh lebih cepat daripada satu dolar yang dikejar melalui penjualan.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Konsep Hari Ini

segments.src: Ask most people what a company does and they'll describe what it sells.
segments.tr: Jika Anda bertanya kepada kebanyakan orang apa yang dilakukan sebuah perusahaan, mereka akan menjelaskan apa yang dijualnya.

segments.src: But look at the income statement of almost any manufacturer, retailer, or restaurant group and you'll find the same thing: the biggest number isn't payroll or rent.
segments.tr: Namun lihatlah laporan laba rugi hampir semua produsen, peritel, atau grup restoran, dan Anda akan menemukan hal yang sama: angka terbesarnya bukanlah gaji atau sewa.

segments.src: It's what the company **bought** — raw materials, components, packaging, freight, contract services.
segments.tr: Angka terbesarnya adalah apa yang perusahaan **beli**: bahan baku, komponen, kemasan, pengiriman, dan jasa kontrak.

segments.src: In many manufacturing firms, purchased goods and services eat more than half of every sales dollar.
segments.tr: Di banyak perusahaan manufaktur, barang dan jasa yang dibeli menyerap lebih dari separuh setiap dolar penjualan.

segments.src: That's why procurement matters, and why it's the sixth stop in this series.
segments.tr: Itulah sebabnya pengadaan penting, dan mengapa ia menjadi pemberhentian keenam dalam seri ini.

segments.src: Here are the four ideas that hold it together.
segments.tr: Berikut empat gagasan yang menopangnya.

segments.src: Purchasing is a transaction.
segments.tr: Pembelian adalah sebuah transaksi.

segments.src: Procurement is a strategy.**
segments.tr: Pengadaan adalah sebuah strategi.**

segments.src: Purchasing is the narrow act of issuing a purchase order and paying the invoice.
segments.tr: Pembelian adalah tindakan sempit menerbitkan purchase order dan membayar faktur.

segments.src: Procurement is the whole arc around it: figuring out what the business actually needs, deciding whether to make it in-house or buy it, finding and qualifying suppliers, negotiating terms, and managing performance for years afterward.
segments.tr: Pengadaan adalah seluruh rangkaian di sekitarnya: menentukan apa yang sebenarnya dibutuhkan bisnis, memutuskan apakah akan dibuat sendiri atau dibeli, menemukan dan memverifikasi pemasok, menegosiasikan syarat, dan mengelola kinerja selama bertahun-tahun setelahnya.

segments.src: Purchasing asks "what's the price?"
segments.tr: Pembelian bertanya "berapa harganya?"

segments.src: Procurement asks "what's the **total cost of ownership**?"
segments.tr: Pengadaan bertanya "berapa **total biaya kepemilikannya**?"

segments.src: Total Cost of Ownership = purchase price
segments.tr: Total Cost of Ownership = purchase price

segments.src: + freight and duties
segments.tr: + freight and duties

segments.src: + inventory carrying cost
segments.tr: + inventory carrying cost

segments.src: + inspection, scrap, and rework
segments.tr: + inspection, scrap, and rework

segments.src: + downtime and expediting
segments.tr: + downtime and expediting

segments.src: + switching or exit costs
segments.tr: + switching or exit costs

segments.src: A part that costs $9.20 instead of $10.00 is not cheaper if it fails inspection twice as often or ships from three weeks farther away.
segments.tr: Suku cadang seharga $9,20 alih-alih $10,00 tidak lebih murah jika ia gagal inspeksi dua kali lebih sering atau dikirim dari tempat yang tiga minggu lebih jauh.

segments.src: Not every purchase deserves the same effort.**
segments.tr: Tidak setiap pembelian layak mendapat usaha yang sama.**

segments.src: The standard tool here is the **Kraljic matrix**, which sorts everything you buy along two axes: how much money is involved, and how risky the supply is (few suppliers, fragile source, long lead time).
segments.tr: Alat standar di sini adalah **Matriks Kraljic**, yang mengelompokkan semua yang Anda beli berdasarkan dua sumbu: seberapa besar uang yang terlibat, dan seberapa berisiko pasokannya (pemasok sedikit, sumber rapuh, waktu tunggu panjang).

segments.src: That gives four quadrants, each with a different playbook:
segments.tr: Hasilnya adalah empat kuadran, masing-masing dengan panduan berbeda:

segments.src: - **Non-critical** (low spend, low risk) — office supplies, cleaning goods. Automate it. Use a catalog, a P-card, and stop thinking about it.
segments.tr: - **Non-kritis** (belanja kecil, risiko rendah): perlengkapan kantor, bahan pembersih. Otomatiskan. Gunakan katalog, kartu pembelian (P-card), dan berhentilah memikirkannya.

segments.src: - **Leverage** (high spend, low risk) — commodity packaging, standard fasteners. Many capable suppliers want your volume. Compete them, consolidate volume, negotiate hard.
segments.tr: - **Pengungkit** (belanja besar, risiko rendah): kemasan komoditas, pengencang standar. Banyak pemasok yang mampu menginginkan volume Anda. Adu mereka, konsolidasikan volume, dan negosiasi dengan keras.

segments.src: - **Bottleneck** (low spend, high risk) — a proprietary sensor, a single certified calibration lab. Small money, big pain if it stops. Hold safety stock, qualify a backup, sign a longer contract.
segments.tr: - **Hambatan** (belanja kecil, risiko tinggi): sensor milik eksklusif, satu laboratorium kalibrasi bersertifikat. Uangnya kecil, tetapi sangat menyakitkan jika berhenti. Simpan stok pengaman, kualifikasikan pemasok cadangan, dan tandatangani kontrak yang lebih panjang.

segments.src: - **Strategic** (high spend, high risk) — the engine, the chip, the signature ingredient. Few alternatives, enormous impact. Build a genuine partnership, share forecasts, invest in the relationship.
segments.tr: - **Strategis** (belanja besar, risiko tinggi): mesin, chip, atau bahan utama. Alternatifnya sedikit, dampaknya sangat besar. Bangun kemitraan yang sungguh-sungguh, bagikan perkiraan, dan investasikan pada hubungan tersebut.

segments.src: The mistake almost every under-resourced team makes is spending its best people on the wrong quadrant — running competitive bids on paper towels while the sole-source component nobody has a backup for quietly becomes an existential risk.
segments.tr: Kesalahan yang hampir selalu dilakukan tim yang kekurangan sumber daya adalah menempatkan orang-orang terbaiknya di kuadran yang keliru: menjalankan tender kompetitif untuk tisu dapur, sementara komponen pemasok tunggal yang tidak punya cadangan diam-diam menjadi risiko eksistensial.

segments.src: Make-or-buy is a strategic choice, not a spreadsheet.**
segments.tr: Membuat-atau-membeli adalah keputusan strategis, bukan sekadar spreadsheet.**

segments.src: Outsourcing tends to win on cost, flexibility, and access to specialized capability.
segments.tr: Alih daya cenderung unggul dalam hal biaya, fleksibilitas, dan akses ke kemampuan khusus.

segments.src: Keeping it in-house tends to win on control, quality assurance, IP protection, and responsiveness.
segments.tr: Melakukannya secara internal cenderung unggul dalam hal kendali, jaminan kualitas, perlindungan HKI, dan daya tanggap.

segments.src: The durable rule of thumb: **outsource what is not your core competency, and be extremely careful outsourcing anything a customer would notice.** The catch is that outsourcing doesn't remove risk — it converts execution risk into supplier risk.
segments.tr: Aturan praktis yang tahan lama: **alihdayakan apa yang bukan kompetensi inti Anda, dan sangat berhati-hatilah mengalihdayakan apa pun yang akan disadari pelanggan.** Namun, alih daya tidak menghilangkan risiko. Ia hanya mengubah risiko eksekusi menjadi risiko pemasok.

segments.src: Boeing's 787 program is the textbook case: an aggressive outsourcing model spread design and fabrication across a deep global supplier tier, and the resulting integration and coordination problems contributed to years of delay.
segments.tr: Program 787 Boeing adalah kasus klasik: model alih daya yang agresif menyebarkan desain dan fabrikasi ke jaringan pemasok global yang luas, dan masalah integrasi serta koordinasi yang muncul ikut menyebabkan penundaan bertahun-tahun.

segments.src: Contracts don't manage relationships.
segments.tr: Kontrak tidak mengelola hubungan.

segments.src: People do.**
segments.tr: Orang yang melakukannya.**

segments.src: **Supplier Relationship Management (SRM)** is the practice of segmenting suppliers, scoring them on real metrics, and investing management attention where it pays off.
segments.tr: **Manajemen Hubungan Pemasok (SRM)** adalah praktik mensegmentasi pemasok, menilai mereka dengan metrik nyata, dan menginvestasikan perhatian manajemen di tempat yang memberi hasil.

segments.src: A typical scorecard runs on **QCDS** — quality (defect rate, PPM), cost (price trend, cost-reduction ideas), delivery (on-time-in-full percentage), and service (responsiveness, technical support).
segments.tr: Kartu skor yang umum menggunakan **QCDS**: kualitas (tingkat cacat, PPM), biaya (tren harga, ide pengurangan biaya), pengiriman (persentase tepat waktu dan lengkap), dan layanan (daya tanggap, dukungan teknis).

segments.src: You cannot run a deep partnership with 4,000 suppliers, and you shouldn't try.
segments.tr: Anda tidak bisa menjalin kemitraan mendalam dengan 4.000 pemasok, dan memang tidak seharusnya mencoba.

segments.src: You run transactional discipline with most of them, preferred-supplier terms with a couple hundred, and true joint development with the handful that determine whether your product is any good.
segments.tr: Anda menjalankan disiplin transaksional dengan sebagian besar dari mereka, persyaratan pemasok pilihan dengan beberapa ratus, dan pengembangan bersama yang sungguh-sungguh dengan segelintir pemasok yang menentukan apakah produk Anda layak.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari

segments.src: Say you run **Trailhead Coffee**, a nine-location café chain in Austin.
segments.tr: Misalkan Anda menjalankan **Trailhead Coffee**, rantai kafe dengan sembilan lokasi di Austin.

segments.src: Annual revenue is $6.2 million, net margin about 5%, and roughly $2.4 million a year goes out the door to suppliers.
segments.tr: Pendapatan tahunan $6,2 juta, margin bersih sekitar 5%, dan sekitar $2,4 juta per tahun mengalir ke pemasok.

segments.src: Your buying list sorts itself into the quadrants almost immediately.
segments.tr: Daftar belanja Anda hampir langsung terurut ke dalam kuadran.

segments.src: **Green coffee beans — strategic.** Around $520,000 a year, and your entire brand rests on it.
segments.tr: **Biji kopi hijau: strategis.** Sekitar $520.000 per tahun, dan seluruh merek Anda bertumpu padanya.

segments.src: There is no interchangeable substitute; customers can taste a switch.
segments.tr: Tidak ada pengganti yang bisa dipertukarkan; pelanggan bisa merasakan perubahannya.

segments.src: So you don't run this on an annual bid.
segments.tr: Jadi Anda tidak menjalankannya lewat tender tahunan.

segments.src: You sign a multi-year agreement with your Chiapas importer, visit the co-op, share your growth forecast so they can plan their crop, and accept that you'll pay a little more for consistency and first call on the good lots.
segments.tr: Anda menandatangani perjanjian multi-tahun dengan importir Chiapas Anda, mengunjungi koperasinya, membagikan perkiraan pertumbuhan agar mereka bisa merencanakan panen, dan menerima bahwa Anda akan membayar sedikit lebih mahal demi konsistensi dan prioritas pertama atas lot terbaik.

segments.src: **Cups, lids, and sleeves — leverage.** About $310,000 a year, and a dozen distributors in Texas would love the business.
segments.tr: **Gelas, tutup, dan sleeve: pengungkit.** Sekitar $310.000 per tahun, dan selusin distributor di Texas ingin mendapatkan bisnis ini.

segments.src: This is where a competitive RFQ pays.
segments.tr: Di sinilah RFQ kompetitif membuahkan hasil.

segments.src: You consolidate all nine stores onto one contract instead of letting each manager order locally, and you land 9% off — roughly $28,000.
segments.tr: Anda mengkonsolidasikan kesembilan toko ke satu kontrak alih-alih membiarkan setiap manajer memesan sendiri, dan Anda mendapatkan diskon 9%, sekitar $28.000.

segments.src: **Espresso machine service — bottleneck.** Maybe $18,000 a year.
segments.tr: **Servis mesin espresso: hambatan.** Mungkin $18.000 per tahun.

segments.src: Trivial money.
segments.tr: Uangnya kecil.

segments.src: But exactly one certified tech in the metro services your machines, and if a grouphead fails on a Saturday at your busiest store, you lose $2,800 in a day.
segments.tr: Namun hanya ada satu teknisi bersertifikat di metropolitan itu yang melayani mesin Anda, dan jika grouphead gagal pada hari Sabtu di toko Anda yang paling ramai, Anda kehilangan $2.800 dalam sehari.

segments.src: So you pay for a service contract with a guaranteed four-hour response, and you keep a spare set of critical parts on the shelf.
segments.tr: Maka Anda membayar kontrak servis dengan jaminan respons empat jam, dan Anda menyimpan set suku cadang kritis cadangan di rak.

segments.src: Small spend, deliberate attention.
segments.tr: Belanja kecil, perhatian yang disengaja.

segments.src: **Office and cleaning supplies — non-critical.** Around $40,000.
segments.tr: **Perlengkapan kantor dan kebersihan: non-kritis.** Sekitar $40.000.

segments.src: Put it on a punch-out catalog with one distributor, give managers a spending limit, and never hold a meeting about it again.
segments.tr: Pindahkan ke katalog punch-out dengan satu distributor, berikan manajer batas pengeluaran, dan jangan pernah mengadakan rapat tentangnya lagi.

segments.src: Now the part that makes the CFO sit up.
segments.tr: Sekarang bagian yang membuat CFO terkejut.

segments.src: That $28,000 saved on cups is $28,000 of pure operating profit.
segments.tr: Penghematan $28.000 pada gelas itu adalah $28.000 laba operasi murni.

segments.src: To generate the same $28,000 through sales at a 5% net margin, you'd have to sell **$560,000** more coffee — roughly a tenth of the entire business.
segments.tr: Untuk menghasilkan $28.000 yang sama lewat penjualan dengan margin bersih 5%, Anda harus menjual kopi **$560.000** lebih banyak, kira-kira sepersepuluh dari seluruh bisnis.

segments.src: That's the **profit-leverage effect**, and it's why procurement is one of the highest-return functions in a company that nobody outside the building ever thinks about.
segments.tr: Itulah **efek pengungkit laba**, dan itulah sebabnya pengadaan adalah salah satu fungsi dengan imbal hasil tertinggi di perusahaan, meskipun tidak pernah dipikirkan oleh siapa pun di luar gedung.

segments.src: The catch: chase that saving into the wrong quadrant — switch to a cheaper green coffee supplier to save $30,000 — and you may lose regulars who never tell you why they stopped coming.
segments.tr: Kuncinya: kejar penghematan itu ke kuadran yang salah, misalnya beralih ke pemasok biji kopi hijau yang lebih murah untuk menghemat $30.000, dan Anda mungkin kehilangan pelanggan tetap yang tidak pernah memberi tahu Anda alasan mereka berhenti datang.

segments.src: Savings that damage the product aren't savings.
segments.tr: Penghematan yang merusak produk bukanlah penghematan.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Rangkuman 3 Baris
